business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides higher and secondary education services and related management services in Mainland China, mainly through PRC operating schools under structured contracts.

segments.business_substance: Tuition, boarding and other education service revenue

business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition and boarding fees are generally paid in advance before each academic year and recognized over the education service period.
business_notes: On-campus students increased to 58,340 at 31 December 2024.
Main PRC schools are operated through structured contracts; the listed group does not directly hold all PRC operating school equity or sponsor interests.

non_recurring_items.item: Income tax on withdrawal of past profits from College of Economics and Business
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Tax charge related to withdrawal of historical profits, not current-year teaching operation cost

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value loss on investment properties
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash valuation loss on investment properties

funds_assets.business_substance: Bank cash, mostly RMB-denominated Mainland China/VIE education group cash

funds_assets.item: Non-pledged time deposits with original maturity less than three months
funds_assets.business_substance: Short time deposits included in cash equivalents

funds_assets.item: Non-pledged time deposits with original maturity more than three months but less than one year
Non-pledged time deposits with original maturity more than one year

operating_assets.business_substance: School buildings, leasehold improvements, electronic equipment and construction in progress
Land use rights, car park and leased buildings used in operations
Includes land-use-right prepayment, acquisition deposits and other operating receivables

investment_assets.business_substance: Commercial properties in Mainland China and Australia held for rental income/capital appreciation
Loan principal and accrued interest due from controlling shareholder Chen Yuguo

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Small property/building lease liabilities; no bank borrowings disclosed at year end

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Advance tuition and boarding fees for unperformed education services; students have refund rights for unrendered services
Salary, student advances, tax payables, receipts on behalf of ancillary providers and other operating payables
Current tax payable, materially affected by withdrawal of past profits

investment_liabilities.business_substance: Committed land lease payments, property/building and furniture/fixture payments

other_liabilities.business_substance: Government grant deferred income and other liabilities

years.source: 2023 Annual Report pp. 128-135 and 2022 Annual Report pp. 136-143

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit in each of 2022-2024, supported by advance-fee collection. However, cash is substantially inside Mainland/VIE education entities, education laws require development funds, and the group is making large land/new-campus commitments.

evidence.value: PRC operating schools controlled through structured contracts

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by parent company, WFOE, VIE schools and individual PRC operating schools.
The annual report does not disclose restricted cash as a separate balance; no pledged deposits were identified in note 20.
Maintenance capex is not explicitly disclosed; regular PPE and software purchases are used as a conservative proxy excluding new land-use-right and investment-property expansion.
